# CWE-798: Amazon MWS auth token — amzn.mws.<uuid> hard-coded.
# Such tokens grant marketplace API access; leaked tokens are reusable.
# ruleid: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
token = amzn.mws.12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc
# ruleid: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
auth = amzn.mws.abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
# ok: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
placeholder = amzn.mws.INVALID-TOKEN
# ok: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
not-a-token = hello world
# ruleid: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
token = amzn.mws.11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
# ruleid: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
creds = amzn.mws.a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
# ok: detected-amazon-mws-auth-token
token = amzn.mws.SHORT
